Source review clears immutable source input only. New tests and plan await root review; production stays locked.
No full tests, build, golden validation, new real clips, PR, dependency installation or production edits were performed.
Plan tail was already executed once before recovery; recovery reads and preserves its closed command/log/result receipt without repetition.
Tail 13 PASS / 4 FAIL proves accepted baseline controls only; direct typed-citation factors and three cached mixed cases still lack the required new roles.
Original 67 historical records retain their original assertion versions. Strengthened full-registry versions were not all rerun; future final-head mandatory matrix is 79 cases.
Restored fetch/DNS/window getter runtime identity proof applies only to this new 17-case tail, not retroactively to the original 67 or subset 41.
Saved mixed-result baseline exact comparison proves only inherited roles/typed placement in saved outputs. It cannot establish candidate parsing or whole-factor GREEN.
